rationale: Ashia is building AI-powered tools to automate research workflows and validation at scale—a direct application of the ML infrastructure and scientific automation expertise she developed at Fermilab and the Smithsonian. Thomas, as a Staff AI Scientist at Intuit, brings deep experience shipping ML applications in production, which could help Ashia think through deployment, scalability, and real-world validation challenges as SymbyAI moves from prototype to scaling across labs and universities.
intro_message: Ashia Livaudais, meet Thomas — you're both deep in applied ML, and Thomas's production deployment experience at Intuit could help stress-test Ashia's AI-driven research validation platform as it scales.
